integrity: The analytic proof supports the theorem; a self-contained numerical checker is corroborative, not a proof of universal identities. No independent audit or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Noiseless planar constant-frequency oscillator; one independent Haar line per step; exact arithmetic; gain two required for unbiased physical-time estimate; fixed-time error only for the specified Euler method; one plausible 2026 broader random-matrix paper was accessible only as an abstract.
title: Exact logarithmic drift and phase fluctuations of Haar-sketched Euler rotation
